qualifier: activated by lysophospholipid receptors, phorbol ester and ionomycin
name: Protein kinase C activation by lysophospholipids and phorbol ester
rationale: Members center on PKC activation by lipid second messengers (lipid/PI phosphorylation, S1P/LPA receptors, PRKCZ, VEGFR2 proliferation) and pharmacological PKC/Ca2+ activators (PMA, ionomycin), whereas confusables emphasize G beta:gamma, PLC-beta, IP3/calcium or BCR signaling.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA hormonal control
name: Glycogen and glucose metabolism under glucagon control
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control, plus glucagon-PKA and AMPK-ChREBP regulation, whereas confusables are dominated by fructose, galactose, pentose and hexose-transport metabolism.

qualifier: RHO, RND and CDC42 subfamilies with formin activation
name: RHO, RND and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: All members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/F, RND2/3, CDC42/RHOU/V or formin activation by RHO, distinguishing the theme from RAC/RHOG-centered and actin-assembly confusables.

qualifier: erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium transport
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium transport
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and Rh-glycoprotein-mediated CO2/ammonium transport, unlike confusables centered on Rh blood group biosynthesis or bicarbonate transport.

qualifier: neural plate, hindbrain segmentation, craniofacial and pharyngeal organs
name: Embryonic neural plate, craniofacial and pharyngeal organ patterning
rationale: Members span early anterior neural plate/border specification, hindbrain rhombomere and D/V patterning, craniofacial skeleton, limbs and pharyngeal-derived glands (thyroid, thymus, parathyroid), whereas confusables emphasize face/ear sensory organs, somitogenesis and Hox clusters.

qualifier: SREBP sterol and ChREBP glucose sensing
name: SREBP and ChREBP nutrient-responsive lipogenic transcription
rationale: Members cover SREBP-driven cholesterol homeostasis and its target motifs plus glucose/ChREBP-mediated carbon catabolite transcription, unlike confusables centered on PKA/glucagon, ATF6/CREB3 or PPAR/LXR nuclear receptors.

core: Striated muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling
qualifier: SERCA uptake, ryanodine release and sodium-calcium exchange
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and sodium-calcium exchange in muscle
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium import, sequestration and ryanodine-receptor release, Na/Ca exchange and the resulting cardiac/skeletal contraction and relaxation, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on plasma-membrane calcium flux, fiber-type switching or caffeine responses.

core: Transcriptional control of fatty acid and glucose homeostasis
qualifier: fasting/caloric restriction and PPARA-driven fatty acid response
name: Fasting-state fatty acid and gluconeogenic transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members link caloric restriction, fatty acid sensing (PPARA, mitochondrial biogenesis), triglyceride/fatty acid homeostasis and nuclear-receptor control of gluconeogenesis, whereas confusables emphasize SREBP/LXR lipogenesis, cholesterol or circadian receptors.

qualifier: right ventricle and morphogenetic apoptosis
name: Cardiac ventricle formation and morphogenetic apoptosis
rationale: Members concern ventricle formation, right ventricle morphogenesis and apoptosis in heart morphogenesis, distinct from confusables on valves/septa, heart field specification or trabecular and atrial myocardium.

qualifier: Rab/ARF regulation and postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors
name: Rab/ARF-regulated endosomal recycling of surface and postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis and endosome-to-surface recycling of receptors via Rab/ARF signaling, including postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking, unlike confusables on Golgi secretion, clathrin cargo recognition or presynaptic vesicle organization.

core: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance
qualifier: intestinal dietary lipid and vitamin E absorption
name: Lipoprotein lifecycle and intestinal dietary lipid absorption
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL assembly, LDL/HDL remodeling and clearance, intestinal lipid and sterol absorption (ABCG5/8) and vitamin E transport, whereas confusables emphasize cholesterol efflux, LXR/SREBP regulation and foam-cell biology.

qualifier: oxidative crosslinking, hyaluronan degradation and ascorbate supply
name: Oxidative extracellular matrix modification, hyaluronan turnover and ascorbate transport
rationale: Members share ECM maturation and remodeling steps (collagen crosslinking, basement membrane assembly, hyaluronan catabolism, stellate activation) together with oxidative/ascorbate-dependent chemistry (protein oxidation, arylsulfatase activation, dehydroascorbate transport via SLC2A10), unlike confusables on collagen synthesis, integrins or sulfation.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling
name: Gap junction electrical coupling in cardiac conduction
rationale: All members concern regulation of cardiac conduction through gap-junction-mediated electrical coupling, whereas confusables address action potential depolarization, conduction-system development or calcium handling.

qualifier: blood-retinal/brain barrier and pigment epithelium
name: Retinal vasculature, pigment epithelium and blood-neural barrier development
rationale: Members concern retinal blood vessel morphogenesis, blood-retina and blood-brain barrier establishment, RPE development and FZD4/matrix signaling, unlike confusables on lens, cornea, hyaloid regression or placenta.

core: Osmotic stress and renal sodium homeostasis
qualifier: osmosensing and aldosterone-regulated sodium/chloride transport
name: Osmosensing and aldosterone-regulated renal sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members combine hyper/hypo-osmotic and salt-stress responses with aldosterone- and renin-linked renal sodium and chloride transport, unlike confusables on vasopressin water handling or potassium transport.

qualifier: deadenylation, decapping and 5'-to-3' exonucleolysis
name: Deadenylation, decapping and 5'-to-3' mRNA decay
rationale: Members regulate poly(A) shortening, decapping, 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay and P-body assembly, distinct from confusables on 3'-end polyadenylation, ARE-binding proteins or miRNA silencing.

core: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and NAD transport
qualifier: ANT-mediated viral apoptosis and nicotinate/NAD salvage
name: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocation, viral permeabilization and NAD salvage
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport, adenine transport, nicotinate/NAD salvage and catabolism, and viral apoptosis via outer-membrane permeabilization, unlike confusables on nucleotide interconversion, creatine or tryptophan-kynurenine NAD synthesis.

qualifier: repair synthesis, strand annealing and sister chromatid exchange
name: Recombinational repair synthesis and sister chromatid exchange
rationale: Members concern DNA repair synthesis during homologous recombination (SDSA, replication-born DSB repair via sister chromatid exchange, mitotic recombination), unlike confusables on telomere maintenance, Fanconi/BRCA signaling or break-induced replication checkpoints.

qualifier: platelet activation, coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis
name: Platelet activation, coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion/activation/degranulation, intrinsic and common coagulation (including F8, F9, FV, VWF defects), contact activation and fibrinolysis, whereas confusables concern eicosanoid synthesis, lipid receptor signaling, integrin-MAPK or vitamin K metabolism.

core: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin metabolism
qualifier: retinoid, vitamin D and vitamin K/gamma-carboxylation
name: Steroidogenesis and vitamin A, D and K metabolism
rationale: Members cover adrenal/gonadal steroid biosynthesis (CYP11/17/19/21 defects) together with retinoid, vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables on thyroid/growth hormone signaling, visual retinoid cycle or phosphate homeostasis.

qualifier: cAMP-PKA and CaMK-CREB signaling with MECP2 regulation
name: Neuronal cAMP-PKA and CaMK-CREB signaling with MECP2
rationale: Members share neuronal second-messenger signaling to the nucleus (adenylate cyclase/PKA, CaMK-CREB, NPAS4) and MECP2 regulation underlying memory, unlike confusables centered on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling and synaptic structural plasticity.

qualifier: cadherin gene transcriptional regulation and EMT restraint
name: Cadherin transcriptional regulation and epithelial identity versus EMT
rationale: Members concern transcriptional control of CDH1/CDH11/CDH19, epithelial identity programs and negative regulation of EMT, distinct from confusables on adherens junction assembly and cadherin post-translational processing.

qualifier: ABCD1-dependent acyl-CoA import, adrenoleukodystrophy
name: Very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoA catabolism and adrenoleukodystrophy
rationale: All members concern breakdown of very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoAs and its ABCD1 defect in ALD, unlike confusables on VLCFA synthesis, peroxisomal protein import or general beta-oxidation.

qualifier: lamina depolymerization and membrane reassembly
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and lamina breakdown and reformation
rationale: Members cover nuclear membrane disassembly, lamina depolymerization and envelope reassembly with protein/pore localization to the envelope, unlike confusables on NPC assembly, nucleocytoplasmic transport or ESCRT-III sealing and abscission.

core: Ribosome biogenesis and nuclear RNA processing
qualifier: pre-rRNA cleavage and exosome-mediated RNA surveillance
name: Pre-rRNA processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members span pre-rRNA cleavage, trimming and 2'-O-methylation, ribosome assembly and RNA exosome 3'-5' decay/surveillance of mRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and tRNA, unlike confusables on RNA base methylation, tRNA processing or telomerase/Cajal body RNA.
